fruits.extendedStory: The parliament calls this tower one of the foremost symbols of Estonian national independence. It measures 45.6 metres from its base to its top. Because Toompea is already high ground, the tip reaches 95 metres above the sea. The domes of the Aleksander Nevski cathedral stand just across from it.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Das Parlament nennt diesen Turm eines der wichtigsten Zeichen estnischer Unabhängigkeit. Vom Fuß bis zur Spitze misst er 45,6 Meter. Weil Toompea selbst schon hoch liegt, reicht die Spitze 95 Meter über den Meeresspiegel. Gleich gegenüber stehen die Kuppeln der Alexander-Newski-Kathedrale.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The parliament calls this tower one of the foremost symbols of Estonian national independence. It measures 45.6 metres from its base to its top. Because Toompea is already high ground, the tip reaches 95 metres above the sea. The domes of the Aleksander Nevski cathedral stand just across from it.

localizedStory.de: Auf diesem Turm geht Estlands Flagge jeden Tag bei Sonnenaufgang hoch, begleitet von Musik.
localizedStory.en: Estonia's flag goes up on this tower every day at sunrise, with music playing.

fruits.name: Pikk Hermann
fruits.story: Estonia's flag goes up on this tower every day at sunrise, with music playing.

fruits.extendedStory: The style is called Russian Revival. It looks back to the shapes of older Russian churches. The cathedral takes its name from Alexander Nevsky. It went up in 1895, right across from the tower where Estonia now raises its flag.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Stil heißt Russischer Historismus. Er greift die Formen älterer russischer Kirchen wieder auf. Benannt ist die Kathedrale nach Alexander Newski. Gebaut wurde sie 1895, direkt gegenüber dem Turm, an dem Estland heute seine Flagge hisst.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The style is called Russian Revival. It looks back to the shapes of older Russian churches. The cathedral takes its name from Alexander Nevsky. It went up in 1895, right across from the tower where Estonia now raises its flag.

localizedStory.de: Mikhail Preobrazhenski entwarf diese Kathedrale von 1895, die an der Lossi plats steht.
localizedStory.en: Mikhail Preobrazhensky designed this cathedral, which dates from 1895 and stands on Lossi plats.

fruits.name: Aleksander Nevski katedraal
fruits.story: Mikhail Preobrazhensky designed this cathedral, which dates from 1895 and stands on Lossi plats.

fruits.extendedStory: The church is Gothic. That means tall pointed arches and windows that pull your eye upward. What was begun in 1201 grew into the building finished in 1438. Its name comes from Olaf the Second, a king of Norway. The town hall stands a short walk away, deeper into the lower town.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Kirche ist gotisch gebaut. Das heißt: hohe Spitzbögen und Fenster, die den Blick nach oben ziehen. Aus dem, was ab 1201 begonnen wurde, entstand der Bau, der 1438 fertig war. Ihren Namen hat sie von Olaf II., einem König von Norwegen. Bis zum Rathaus ist es von hier nur ein kurzes Stück.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The church is Gothic. That means tall pointed arches and windows that pull your eye upward. What was begun in 1201 grew into the building finished in 1438. Its name comes from Olaf the Second, a king of Norway. The town hall stands a short walk away, deeper into the lower town.

localizedStory.de: Diese Kirche trägt den Namen von Olaf II. von Norwegen und steht hier seit 1201.
localizedStory.en: This church carries the name of Olaf the Second of Norway, and has stood here since 1201.

fruits.name: Oleviste kirik
fruits.story: This church carries the name of Olaf the Second of Norway, and has stood here since 1201.

localizedStory.de: Tallinns Rathaus wurde 1404 eröffnet und steht bis heute an seinem eigenen Platz.
localizedStory.en: Tallinn's town hall opened in 1404 and still stands on its own square.

fruits.name: Raekoda
fruits.story: Tallinn's town hall opened in 1404 and still stands on its own square.

fruits.extendedStory: The platform sits on the northern side of Toompea Hill, the high ground above the old town. From the rail you look straight down onto the roofs below. On a clear day the Gulf of Finland, the harbour and Pirita show up beyond them. Few places in the city let you see so far at once.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Plattform liegt an der Nordseite des Toompea-Hügels, oben über der Altstadt. Vom Geländer schaust du senkrecht auf die Dächer hinunter. An klaren Tagen tauchen dahinter der Finnische Meerbusen, der Hafen und Pirita auf. Weiter kommt der Blick in dieser Stadt kaum.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The platform sits on the northern side of Toompea Hill, the high ground above the old town. From the rail you look straight down onto the roofs below. On a clear day the Gulf of Finland, the harbour and Pirita show up beyond them. Few places in the city let you see so far at once.

localizedStory.de: Von diesem Vorsprung an Toompeas Nordseite öffnen sich Hafen und Finnischer Meerbusen in der Ferne.
localizedStory.en: From this ledge on Toompea's northern side the harbour and the Gulf of Finland open up in the distance.

fruits.name: Kohtuotsa vaateplatvorm
fruits.story: From this ledge on Toompea's northern side the harbour and the Gulf of Finland open up in the distance.

fruits.extendedStory: Walk round to the south side and look up. Stone cannonballs are still sitting in the wall. Ivan the Terrible's troops fired them at the tower during the siege of January to March 1577. When the holes were patched, the balls were left where they struck, as a reminder. The tower had already stood since 1475.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Geh außen um die Südseite herum und schau nach oben. In der Mauer stecken noch immer steinerne Kanonenkugeln. Die Truppen Iwans des Schrecklichen schossen sie bei der Belagerung von Januar bis März 1577 gegen den Turm. Als man die Löcher zumauerte, ließ man die Kugeln als Erinnerung stecken. Da stand der Turm schon seit 1475.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Walk round to the south side and look up. Stone cannonballs are still sitting in the wall. Ivan the Terrible's troops fired them at the tower during the siege of January to March 1577. When the holes were patched, the balls were left where they struck, as a reminder. The tower had already stood since 1475.

localizedStory.de: Sein Name heißt auf Niederdeutsch Guck in die Küche: von hier oben sah man, was der Feind kochte.
localizedStory.en: Its name is Low German for peek into the kitchen: from up here you could watch what the enemy was cooking.

fruits.name: Kiek in de Kök
fruits.story: Its name is Low German for peek into the kitchen: from up here you could watch what the enemy was cooking.

fruits.extendedStory: The map here says dolphin. The records say something else: Poisid kalaga, boys with a fish. Voldemar Mellik shaped the two figures, and the fountain dates from 1947. Look closely at what they are gripping and decide for yourself.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Auf der Karte steht Delfin. In den Verzeichnissen steht etwas anderes: Poisid kalaga, Jungen mit einem Fisch. Die Figuren stammen von Voldemar Mellik, der Brunnen von 1947. Schau genau hin, was die beiden da festhalten, und entscheide selbst.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The map here says dolphin. The records say something else: Poisid kalaga, boys with a fish. Voldemar Mellik shaped the two figures, and the fountain dates from 1947. Look closely at what they are gripping and decide for yourself.

localizedStory.de: Voldemar Mellik schuf diesen Brunnen 1947 — und das Tier, das die Jungen halten, ist ein Fisch.
localizedStory.en: Voldemar Mellik made this fountain in 1947 — and the creature the boys are holding is a fish.

fruits.name: Poisid delfiiniga
fruits.story: Voldemar Mellik made this fountain in 1947 — and the creature the boys are holding is a fish.

localizedStory.de: Schau hoch: vierundzwanzig Meter Turm stehen hier an der Müürivahe.
localizedStory.en: Look up: twenty-four metres of stone tower stand here on Müürivahe.

fruits.name: Assauwe torn
fruits.story: Look up: twenty-four metres of stone tower stand here on Müürivahe.
